title: Finite cylinder approximation of ruled sets
coverage: Read the whole paper (intro, linear coverings, finite approximation, product methods, comparison). Checked every step of the main Theorem 1.2 proof: (a) Lemma 2.1, the fixed-point covering for centers (i+αj, βi+j) when 0≤αβ<1. The composed rounding map is monotone in all sign cases, F(i)=αβ i+O(1) gives an invariant interval, and the rounding error ≤1/2 handles the closed boundaries. (b) Lemma 2.2, the zero-diagonal orthonormal basis, by the intermediate value theorem on q(e)+q(e^⊥)=tr A=0. (c) Lemma 2.3: the parameter product s^2 bc=-s^2 det A lies in [0,1). The inverse (I+sA)^{-1}=(I-sA)/(1+s^2 det A) follows from Cayley–Hamilton, and the denominator is at least 1+L^2 det A because det A≤0. (d) Section 3: σ>0 by compactness; the Taylor bound |V-V_S|≤√2 δ ω(√2 δ); the identity p+sV(p)-l-sV_S(l)=(I+sA_S)(p-l)+s(V(p)-V_S(p)), giving R_δ=o(δ) with τ=δ^2; a retained list that is finite and independent of p and s; the collar area (δ+2R+2τ)^2; the J_h weight is Lipschitz, so the error is O(δ); the number of coarse squares is O(δ^{-2}); and |U_δ \ D|→0 by continuity from above, so no boundary regularity is needed. Also checked Proposition 1.1 (the Jacobian |n·v̂|=J_h with v=(1,g1,hg2)) and the example V=(p2,p1^3/3). Also checked the secondary Theorem 4.1 and Corollary 4.4, which the main result does not need: the cell area 4B(1+log(A^2/B)), the error margin τ+4ε+ε²<(1+γ)τ when 5ε<γτ, the uniform eigenvector conditioning by compactness, the packing fraction β|Q|/128, the residual disk cost 8πh(1+MK)^2 s^2, and the finite-subcover step. The only things not checked were the literature attributions (Kolountzakis, Bezdek–Litvak). They are not used in the proofs.
main_claim: Let D⊂R^2 be compact and V a C^1 field with tr DV=0 and -L^{-2}<det DV≤0 on D. Then E(D,V,L) can be covered by finitely many cylinders with square intercept tiles, and their total weighted cost Σ|T_i|J_h(g_i) is at most ∫_D J_h(V)+ε.
sibling_notes: There were no sibling entries in family 100 when this was checked. The paper is self-contained; its only external inputs are elementary.
